0022600092.text: Portland hosts Phoenix in a season opener for both teams, as neither has played a 2026-27 game yet. The Trail Blazers will be without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Deni Avdija (ankle) and Micah Potter (illness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and the Trail Blazers lost 1-2 to the Suns in the 2025-26 season series but won their last meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
